title: Cost I for academic year tuition reporters
note:
Numeric fields should be right-justified in their fields. Both leading zeros and spaces are permissible.

Character data should be left justified.

Doctor's-professional table

  1. Chiropractic (D.C. or D.C.M.)
  2. Dentistry (D.D.S. or D.M.D.)
  3. Medicine (M.D.)
  4. Optometry (O.D.)
  5. Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.)
  6. Pharmacy (Pharm. D.)
  7. Podiatry (Pod.D., D.P., or D.P.M.)
  8. Veterinary Medicine (D.V.M.)
  9. Law ( J.D.)
Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students
1 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students enrolled in Fall 2024 [Section 2: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 01]
2 - Number of full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying in-district tuition rates. [Section 2: Part B, Line 02]
3 - Number of first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying in-state tuition rates. [Section 2: Part B, Line 03]
4 - Number full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying out-of-state tuition rates. [Section 2: Part B, Line 04]
5 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying unknown tuition rates. [Section 2: Part B, Line 05] (Do not include in import file. It will be generated.)

Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate who were awarded grant or scholarship aid from the following sources: the federal government, state/local government, or the institution
1 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate who were awarded grant or scholarship aid from the following sources: the federal government, state/local government, or the institution. [Section 2: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 02]
2 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded grant or scholarship aid living on-campus.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part C, Line 02]
3 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded grant or scholarship aid living off-campus with family.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part C, Line 03]
4 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded grant or scholarship aid living off-campus not with family.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part C, Line 04]
5 - Total grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, or the institution awarded to students.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part C, Line 06]
6 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded grant or scholarship aid with unknown living arrangement.
Do not include in import file. It will be generated. [Section 2: Part C, Line 05]
7 - Average amount of grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, or the institution.
Do not include in import file. It will be generated. [Section 2: Part C, Line 07]

Aid Year Code

1 - Fall 2024, academic year 2024-25
2 - Fall 2023, academic year 2023-24 (If you have reported to IPEDS previously, do not include in import file. It will be generated.)
3 - Fall 2022, academic year 2022-23 (If you have reported to IPEDS previously, do not include in import file. It will be generated.)

Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students Awarded Title IV Aid
1 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate who were awarded any Title IV federal student aid.
When YEAR=1, [Section 2: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 03]. When Year=2,3, [Section 2: Part D, Line 01]
2 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any Title IV aid living on-campus.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part D, Line 02]
3 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any Title IV aid living off-campus with family.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part D, Line 03]
4 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any Title IV aid living off-campus not with family.
Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate. [Section 2: Part D, Line 04]
5 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any Title IV aid with unknown living arrangement.
Do not include in import file. It will be generated. [Section 2: Part D, Line 05]

Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students who were awarded any Title IV federal student aid by income

1 - $0-$30,000. Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate.
2 - $30,001-$48,000. Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate.
3 - $48,001-$75,000. Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate.
4 - $75,001-$110,000. Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate.
5 - $110,001 and more. Include only the students paying the lower of in-state or in-district tuition rate.
6 - Total all income levels. Do not include in import file. It will be generated.

fixedLayoutParts.title: Section 1 - Cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students
fixedLayoutParts.instruction:
Cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students for academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
These are the data that will be available to the public on the College Navigator website. If institution does not offer undergraduate level awards or does not have any first-time full-time students, DE011 through DE13 are not applicable, and no Part "E" record should be included on the file. Out-of-state amount DE03 and DE06 should be consistent with DA07(DA071, DA072, DA073) above. If institution only charges one tuition rate for all students, then report these amounts using the in-district variables. If institution does not provide on-campus housing and food or meal plans, then DE08 should be -2 or blank (not applicable). If you want to change data reported for academic year 2023-24 or 2024-25, you must do it on the Cost II component in the Winter collection. If you would like to enter a caveat for these data, you must also enter the caveat in the data collection system.

fixedLayoutParts.title: Section 1 - Undergraduate student charges (Tuition and Required Fees)
fixedLayoutParts.instruction:
Charges to full-time and part-time undergraduate students for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
If institution does not offer undergraduate level awards, DB01-DB15 are not applicable, and no Part "B" record should be included on the file. If institution offers undergraduate level awards, but has only part-time students, then only DB07, DB08, DB09, DB13, DB14, and DB15 are applicable; all other variables should be blank or -2. Out-of-state amounts DB03, DB06, DB09, DB12, and DB15 should be consistent with DA07(DA071, DA072, DA073) above. If institution only charges one tuition rate for all students, then report these amounts using the in-district variables.

Instructions:
If institution does not offer graduate level awards, DC01-DC15 are not applicable, and no Part "C" record should be included on the file. If institution offers graduate level awards, but has only part-time students, then only DC07, DC08, DC09, DC13, DC14, and DC15 are applicable; all other variables should be -2 or blank. Out-of-state amounts DC03, DC06, DC09, and DC15 should be consistent with DA07(DA071, DA072, DA073) above. If institution only charges one tuition rate for all students, then report these amounts using the in-district variables.

Please, do not include tuition for Doctor's Degree - Professional Practice programs.

If institution does not charge different tuition for out-of-state students, then valid amounts for DF04 and DF05 are -2 or blank (not applicable).

fixedLayoutParts.title: Section 1 - Food and Housing charges
fixedLayoutParts.instruction:
Typical food and housing charges for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
Food and housing charges should be consistent with DA08 and DA10 above. If institution does not provide on-campus housing or food or meal plans, no Part "D" record should be included on the file. If institution does provide food and housing, but does not separate food and housing charges, provide combined charge in DD03, and leave DD01 and DD02 as -2 or blank (not applicable).

This section is not required from non-degree-granting institutions.

keyValueParts.title: Section 1 - Undergraduate student charges (Tuition and Required Fees)
keyValueParts.instruction:
Charges to full-time and part-time undergraduate students for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
If institution does not offer undergraduate level awards, DB01-DB12 are not applicable, and no Part "B" record should be included on the file. If a variable is not applicable, do not include in import file. If institution offers undergraduate level awards, but has only part-time students, then only DB07, DB08, DB09, DB13, DB14, and DB15 are applicable. Out-of-state amounts DB03, DB06, DB09, DB12, and DB15 should be consistent with DA07(DA071, DA072, DA073) above. If institution only charges one tuition rate for all students, then report these amounts using the in-district variables.

keyValueParts.title: Section 1 - Graduate student charges (Tuition and Required Fees)
keyValueParts.instruction:
Charges to full-time and part-time graduate students for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
If institution does not offer graduate level awards, DC01-DC15 are not applicable, and no Part "C" record should be included on the file. If institution offers graduate level awards, but has only part-time students, then only DC07, DC08, DC09, DC13, DC14, and DC15 are applicable; all other variables should be -2 or blank. Out-of-state amounts DC03, DC06, DC09, and DC15 should be consistent with DA07(DA071, DA072, DA073) above. If institution only charges one tuition rate for all students, then report these amounts using the in-district variables.

Please, do not include tuition for Doctor's Degree - Professional Practice programs.

keyValueParts.title: Section 1 - Doctor's-Professional Practice student charges (Tuition and Required Fees)
keyValueParts.instruction:
Charges to full-time Doctor's-Professional Practice students for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
This section is applicable only to 4-year schools that offer Doctor's-Professional Practice degrees. If your institution does not offer this level of award, do not include any Part "F" records in the file. If institution does not charge different tuition for out-of-state students, then valid amounts for DF04 and DF05 are -2 or blank (not applicable).

keyValueParts.title: Section 1 - Food and Housing charges
keyValueParts.instruction:
Typical food and housing charges for the full academic year 2025-26

Instructions:
Food and housing charges should be consistent with DA08 and DA10 above. If institution does not provide on-campus housing or food or meal plans, no Part "D" record should be included on the file. If institution does provide food and housing, but does not separate food and housing charges, provide combined charge in DD03, and leave DD01 and DD02 as -2 or blank (not applicable).

This section is not required from non-degree-granting institutions.
